mechanism: L-QF1: the local proposal quadratic in _em1_dynamic_descent is corrected from the non-contracting form "krba,bij,krbj->krb" to "krbi,bij,krbj->krb", so the local cost is delta^T G delta rather than (sum_a delta_a) * sum_j (sum_i G_ij) delta_j. Every other fixed choice is the parent's own code, byte for byte.
parent: v230 Linear L-EM2 + v195 Attention complete root
parent_official: 18428 / 292s (promoted; the only officially measured root this candidate descends from)
build: append-only onto the parent: parent bytes + fixed separator + implementation module. Every parent byte, both hooks, the Attention four APIs and all shared helpers are byte-identical; the only dead code is the parent's now-shadowed _em1_dynamic_descent.

build_is_derived_not_handwritten.what: build.py does not hand-write the override. It cuts the parent's own _em1_dynamic_descent source out of the parent bytes, substitutes one substring, and appends that text. The 'sole change' claim is therefore measured rather than asserted.
build_is_derived_not_handwritten.refusal_rule: build.py exits non-zero unless the differing-byte count is exactly 1, the parent SHA256 and byte count match the registered values, the generated module is exactly HEADER + function, the function holds the corrected string exactly once and the buggy one never, the candidate holds exactly 2 definitions and exactly 1 call site, and the candidate starts with the parent's bytes.

the_defect.why_the_parent_form_is_wrong: the first operand's summed index `a` appears only in the first operand and the second operand's summed index `i` only in the second (only `j` is shared), so the two sums never meet and the contraction evaluates to (sum_a delta_a) * sum_j (sum_i G_ij) delta_j -- the column sums of G against the total displacement, not delta^T G delta.
the_defect.not_an_equivalent_reassociation: changing which index couples is a formula change, not a reassociation of the same sum. It is priced as a mechanism change and is the sole behavioural edit in this candidate.
the_defect.it_is_the_file_s_own_idiom: the parent root already contracts a quadratic form correctly at solution.py:1983, using "krbi,bij,krbj->krb" for e^T H e in the weight encoder. The corrected string is copied from the file, not invented.
the_defect.degenerate_form_on_the_real_candidate_se: all 8 pm1 candidates are single-coordinate (element_index=[0,0,1,1,2,2,3,3], one true entry per row mask), so delta = c * e_m with c = +-0.25 and the two spellings reduce exactly to c^2 * colsum(G)[m] (parent) against c^2 * G[m,m] (corrected). The parent was ranking candidates by a column sum.

what_the_fix_does_to_the_accept_test.claim: J(X) = ||(X - T) W_hat^T||^2 is quadratic in X, so J(x+d) - J(x) = 2 * grad J . d + d^T G d is an identity and not a second-order approximation. After the fix the accept test's cost equals the true objective difference; before it, it did not.
what_the_fix_does_to_the_accept_test.independent_reference: verify.py evaluates J at two points in float64 dense matmul and differences them; the subject under test is the subscript string read out of the shipped source by regex, so the control cannot drift from what ships.

real_data_mechanism_probe.why: verify.py control D runs the shipped descent on a real activation from the calibration cache, so the candidate's effect is measured on real data and not only on synthetic grams.
real_data_mechanism_probe.proposal_ranking: 4864 of 81920 proposal slots (5.94%) picked a different candidate; the accept decision differed in 5491 places

honest_scoping_of_the_failure_mode.what_the_defect_can_do: a positive-definite Gram can have a negative column sum -- verify.py control Q5 uses G=[[1,-2],[-2,10]], eigenvalues 0.5756/10.4244, column sum of column 0 = -1.0 -- so the parent form can report a benefit for a move that actually costs, i.e. a sign flip that accepts a loss.
honest_scoping_of_the_failure_mode.what_it_actually_did_here: on real layer-0/q data, 0 of 2560 local grams had a negative column sum. The observed consequence is a magnitude mis-ranking, not a sign flip.
honest_scoping_of_the_failure_mode.why_both_are_recorded: the counterexample is the evidence that the formula is wrong; the 0/2560 count is the evidence that it was not already causing spurious accepts on this data. Reporting only the counterexample would overstate the defect; reporting only the count would understate it.

time.claim: L-QF1 adds no measurable time. The change is one character inside a subscript string; the einsum operand shapes, the step count and the loop structure are unchanged, and build.json records exactly one differing byte in the function text as the mechanical evidence.
time.controlled_measurement: shard 0 in-process paired, both arms alternating inside the timed region under one shared calibration: candidate dynamic API 42.2156s / 56 calls against baseline 43.1058s / 56 calls, i.e. the candidate is 0.89s faster and in any case not slower.
time.cross_process_bracket: against the archived linear-em3-v230base run the candidate reads 42.2156s against 41.934s, i.e. 0.28s slower. The two comparisons bracket zero.
time.noise: per-shard cross-process dynamic differences across the six shards span -3.22s to +2.16s over ~42s of work; the process-to-process noise is an order of magnitude larger than any difference attributable to this change.
time.not_comparable: the candidate-side api_total includes a cold calibration cache for the new SHA while the archived baseline served its calibration from cache, so absolute api_total figures are not a controlled comparison and are not used as timing evidence.
time.official_projection_note: no projection is recorded. The change is time-neutral by construction and measurement, so the honest statement is that this candidate should cost the root's 292s, but local measurement cannot settle official seconds and the plan retires local time prediction.
